reason: Instruction fetch and PMP checking for branch targets/straddling fetches are typically handled in the IF stage; a missed second fetch-side PMP check would likely originate here.
This file implements the PMP address matching/permission logic, including TOR region boundary behavior. An off-by-one or multi-fetch permission bug could directly live here.
Ibex may use the prefetch buffer to issue/fuse instruction requests. If a 32-bit instruction crosses a PMP boundary, the buffer/request splitting logic could fail to perform both checks.
If the configuration uses instruction cache paths, cache-line fetch and PMP interaction can affect whether a straddling instruction causes the proper access fault.
This is a verification-side interface for fetch/PMP observation; less likely than RTL, but useful if the mismatch stems from incorrect modeling of instruction fetch PMP checks in cosim.
